toolsBlock:
# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type":"function","function":{"name":"weather","description":"Weather for a place.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"place":{"type":"string"},"lat":{"type":"number"}}}}}
{"type":"function","function":{"name":"set_reminder","description":"A reminder.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string"},"in_minutes":{"type":"number"},"repeat":{"type":"string","enum":["none","daily"]}},"required":["text"]}}}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>
